title: ever LINDEN|High Slit V-Neck Chiffon High Waist Bridesmaid Dress with Ruffle Sleeve
descriptionHtml:
Designed with a V-neck and high slit, this A-line chiffon bridesmaid dress showcases ruffle sleeves and a high waist. The pleated details add a refined touch, making it an ideal pick for a chic wedding look.


Fit: Please refer to size chart.


Length: Floor Length.


Sleeve Style: Short Sleeves.


Closure: It is concealed a zipper up the back.


Undergarments: It is not padded, with lining.


Fabric:The garment comprises chiffon.


Stretch: Fabric is no stretch.
